<thought>Using the standard DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the given molecular formula C16H15O (no N or halogens), DBE = (2*16 + 2 - 15)/2 = 19/2 = 9.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the correct integer value is 10 (rounding up to the nearest whole number for a stable structure).</thought>
<final_answer>10</final_answer>
